metadata.purpose: JRN-1 fixture: the smallest jwt-mode app that carries the built-in identity pack, so the daily journey suite (sign up, password reset, accept an invitation, sign in, change password, sign out, revoke other sessions) can drive the REAL login, e-mail and session paths of a generated app. Not a demo: a FIXTURE for scripts/quality/run-journeys.ps1. Mail goes through mail-smtp to a throwaway local SMTP sink the runner starts, so no real mail dependency exists.
